label: conformance vectors for the gates scorers and the table cover; no claim

rules.id: sha256 of the sorted, compact UTF-8 JSON of {name, inputs}
rules.blobs: inputs.prereg and inputs.receipt name bytes in blobs.json by sha256
rules.receipt: json.loads over the receipt bytes decoded as UTF-8
rules.frozen: research_capsule.score_frozen(protocol._select_gates_block(prereg.decode('utf-8')), receipt); no newline translation, no smoke branch
rules.experiment: protocol.Experiment(<the PREREG written to disk and committed>).score(receipt, smoke=bool(receipt.get('smoke'))), the reading of styxx.seal
rules.rescore: styxx.prereg_ci.core.rescore(prereg, receipt), compared on the keys the vector holds
rules.compare: styxx.prereg_ci.core.compare(rescore, inputs.recorded, sealed=inputs.sealed, declared=inputs.declared), compared on code and kind
rules.outcome: {verdict, gates, gates_sha256}, or {raises, at, message}: the class always, the message for GateSpecError only
rules.agree: frozen and experiment both refuse, or both give the same verdict, gates and digest
